stories.text: Israelis vote in a pivotal election centred on security and democracy, amid fears neither main bloc will win a majority.
With the Budget close, Burnham faces a growing pile of difficult issues, from Brexit debates to North Sea oil.
The chancellor will scrap tariffs on some staple goods to ease cost of living pressure on households.
Harry Kane wins the men's Ballon d'Or, the first English winner since Michael Owen in 2001, while Alexia Putellas wins a third women's award.
James Comey, former FBI chief, faces a third set of federal charges, linked to alleged 2016 disclosures of classified material to the New York Times.
Sales of torches, radios and power banks have jumped sharply after the government urged people to stock up on essentials.
Jay-Z will perform at the Super Bowl half-time show for the first time, despite years of involvement with the event.
Storm Boelo leaves thousands without power, as a yellow wind warning covers western coasts of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern Northern Ireland.
A ceasefire announced by Melania Trump begins in a war-hit Ukrainian city, aiming to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations.
Apple says it will replace iPhone Duo handsets, its first foldable phone, after photos online showed screen faults.
